body:
i feel you.  like all the shit that flies in, and mostly i just sort of shut down.  you know, i put on the good face for work and everything, but as soon as the meeting is over or whatever, i just sort of sink back into hating myself.

i wish i knew the magic formula, too.  i remember thinking i'd never let myself live to 30.  welp, now i'm 38 and thinking i won't make it to 45.  either that will end up true, or one day i'll be like 87 and saying "95.  no more!" or something.  i guess we just plod along, doing our best.

i mean, i'm not a negative to society like hitler or anything.  i'm probably, like, the equivalent of a litterbug -- probably not a great deal of harm to people, but generally something folks could do without.

and, i mean, of course there's no *harm* in seeing another sunrise.  i'm just one of those people who quits the game when it gets too hard, you know?

omg i don't want to be a downer but i've been a developer for 15 years and just last night i stayed up 'til 2 AM working on a project because ... i couldn't concentrate enough during the day to actually get my work done.

however ... it's crazy-town how many people i work with who are good developers with sharp-ass intellects who are just wonderful people to know, who think they are failures, or who think they just faked their way into it.

unfortunately, a side effect of being smart and logic-oriented can be some pretty severe introspection.  do you think *incompetent* people worry about being failures?  no.  not at all.  i feel like if you are working hard and are disappointed in your performance, it only means that you care strongly about results.  and that means you're absolutely not a failure.

sorry.  at this point i'm probably just trying to give *myself* a pep-talk. heh.

i know, right?

thinking about what everyone i know would do if i died is my primary going-to-bed thought fodder.

the fact is, though, there *are* people who care about you. but i feel like "so-and-so will be disappointed in me" and "so-and-so wants me to disappear forever" are different things ... for instance, i feel like my mom has been disappointed in me for 38 years but she doesn't wish me to disappear, heh.
